article.title: Abdul El-Sayed's Senate Victory in Michigan
article.author: bareditors
article.content: Abdul El-Sayed's Senate Victory in Michigan Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 11/06/2026 - 08:44 Abayomi Azikiwe is editor of the Pan-African Newswire and a Detroit-based activist. Abdul El-Sayed won his election and will represent Michigan as a United States senator. He defied the Democratic Party and its donor class, but is his victory truly meaningful to the voters who rejected Islamophobia and AIPAC's attacks? US Politics Abdul el Sayed Michigan Congress AIPAC Democratic party
